brand.name: IPTV Prime
brand.summary: 4K IPTV subscription provider serving households in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada with 20,000+ live channels, live 4K sports & PPV, and 60,000+ VOD movies and series.

service_highlights.activation_time: Under 60 seconds via WhatsApp or Telegram

categories: Sports (1,200+ Live Channels: Premier League, Champions League, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, UFC, PPV Boxing, Formula 1)
Movies & Series VOD (60,000+ 4K UHD Titles & Boxsets)

faqs.question: Can I test IPTV Prime with a free trial before subscribing?
faqs.answer: Yes. IPTV Prime provides a 24-hour evaluation pass so you can test our USA, UK, and Canadian channel lineup, live sports streams, and 4K VOD library before subscribing.

faqs.question: Which devices and apps are supported?
faqs.answer: IPTV Prime works on Amazon Firestick, Samsung and LG Smart TVs, Apple TV, iOS, Android TV, MAG boxes, Windows, and macOS using TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, and IBO Player.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Major credit and debit cards via Stripe, PayPal, and select cryptocurrencies (BTC, USDT) in USD, GBP, or CAD.

faqs.question: What is your refund policy?
faqs.answer: All plans include a 7-day satisfaction guarantee if our technical desk cannot resolve persistent playback issues on your connection.

compliance_notice: Content availability varies by region. Service provided as-is. Subscribers are responsible for compliance with local regulations in their jurisdiction.
